research_question: Can fault/severity world identity still be routed from exactly the information available during held-out adaptation when both trajectory and speed are unseen by the router?

prior_result.identified_scope_mismatch: The diagnostic combined feature used source-header session time and whole-flight statistics. Both exceed the proposed candidate-visible adaptation boundary. This new audit does not edit or reinterpret the prior observation; it tests a separately preregistered, stricter visibility contract.

immutable_inputs.audited_files: 72 faulty files from t1,t2,t3,t5, nine fault/severity labels, two speeds

adaptation_view.usable_interval: central 80 percent after a 32-sample history and one-step target guard
adaptation_view.zone: first 20 percent of the usable interval
adaptation_view.anchor_rule: deterministic equal-bin centers; no random seed
adaptation_view.visible_samples: union of each anchor's 32-sample history for all ten channels plus the one-step six-state adaptation target
adaptation_view.length_feature: number of visible adaptation scalars only, not raw whole-flight length

feature_groups.amplitude: per visible channel mean, standard deviation, 10/50/90 percentiles and range
feature_groups.histogram: per-channel counts after normalization by that adaptation view only, with fixed bins [-inf,-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2,inf]
feature_groups.lag: per-channel lag-1 correlation within each anchor history, averaged across 32 anchors; zero when variance is below 1e-12
feature_groups.combined: concatenate amplitude, histogram and lag; standardize from the training fold only
feature_groups.prohibited_ablation: A source-header session feature is computed only as a privileged diagnostic and cannot affect pass/fail.

cross_validation.rule: For each held-out (trajectory, speed) cell, test its nine worlds and train only on the other speed and other three trajectories. Thus neither the held-out trajectory nor speed appears in training.
cross_validation.classifier: nearest class centroid with Euclidean distance, deterministic smallest-label tie break

uncertainty.observed_interval: two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval over 72 held-out predictions
uncertainty.null: Independently permute the nine world labels inside each trajectory-speed cell, preserving exact balance; rerun the complete nested classifier.

decision_rule.pass_for_protected_evaluator_migration: All candidate-visible feature groups have accuracy <= 0.25, combined accuracy <= max(0.25, null_q95), combined permutation p >= 0.05, and the visible-view audit has zero forbidden access.
decision_rule.reject_before_implementation: Any candidate-visible group exceeds 0.25, combined exceeds max(0.25, null_q95), combined p < 0.05, or any visibility/integrity check fails.
decision_rule.threshold_rationale: 0.25 is fixed before implementation, is stricter than the prior 0.35 ceiling, and is more than twice the 1/9 chance level. It is not chosen from the new result.
decision_rule.privileged_session_rule: Privileged session accuracy is reported diagnostically but never used to pass or reject.

invalidation: Invalidate if the code reads any selected-channel value outside the frozen adaptation view for a candidate-visible feature.
Invalidate if labels enter feature construction or standardization, except class-centroid aggregation after the fold is frozen.
Invalidate if a fold trains on the held-out trajectory or speed.
Invalidate if the permutation count, seed, p-value, quantile rule, 0.25 ceiling or feature definition changes after any output is observed.
Invalidate on corpus/hash mismatch, STOP/PAUSE, external model/API use, predictive scoring or protected evaluator mutation.

outcome_policy.pass: Authorize only a later protected service migration with no scoring; do not create a hypothesis or experiment in this wake.
outcome_policy.reject: Abandon this exact DronePropA transfer protocol and choose a different corpus or causal question rather than tune the router gate.
outcome_policy.uncertainty: A boundary result is governed mechanically by the frozen inequalities and reported with the Wilson interval and permutation p-value.
